The company operates through a hybrid model of cloud kitchens and dine-in outlets, leveraging about 70% automation for efficient, scalable production. With well-known brands such as Itlu Bobbatlu, The Fruit Custard, and Jarley Desserts, Matka Foods reaches customers via platforms like Swiggy, Zomato, and its own e-commerce site, bookmydessert.com. This position offers exposure to decision-making at a food tech startup and the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership on high-impact initiatives. title: Associate Applied AI Product Manager Intern - Learning Product
description: About the Role NxtWave teaches tens of thousands of students across NIAT (our 4-year campus program), NxtWave Academy, and Intensive. The hard problem now is whether a student actually learns, practises, stays engaged, and improves. In this role, you will work on that problem directly, taking real challenges and owning them end to end: Understand: Engage directly with students, instructors, and internal teams, pairing qualitative insights with data analysis. Build: Create functional, hands-on prototypes independently using AI-assisted tools. Test: Deploy prototypes to real users, execute A/B tests, and rigorously measure behavioral changes. Iterate: Rapidly refine and re-release solutions until they demonstrate measurable scale and impact. This is not a traditional PM role. You will not write specs and wait for execution teams to build them. You think like a product manager, build like an engineer, and care deeply about how students learn. Approximately half of the role focuses on product and engineering work, while the remaining half covers pedagogy and operations. Focus Areas A. Learning Platform (Student-Facing) Build and test AI capabilities that transform how students practise, revise, tackle quizzes, and stay engaged. Focus areas include exam-prep assistants, interactive practice games, and structured evening (610 PM) learning workflows. Success is measured by time spent, assessment performance, and retention rates. B. Agentic Workflows (Internal Operations) Design and refine AI agents and internal workflows used daily by subject-matter experts and content teams to create and review learning materials. Success is measured by tool adoption, hours saved, and overall content quality. C. Product Experience Layer Reimagine core elements of the learning product from an AI-native perspectivewhere AI forms the core driver rather than an added feature. Guide concepts from initial hypothesis through prototyping to production deployment. What You'll Do Problem to Prototype Pick up a real problem statement in your first week and perform deep root-cause analysis before proposing solutions. Build functional prototypes rapidly using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor) and internal agent frameworks. Guide AI models effectively: write structured prompts, audit output accuracy, and identify hallucinations or failure modes promptly. Release, Measure, Iterate Launch features to live cohorts, starting with targeted groups, specific universities, or individual teams before broader rollout. Define target success metrics prior to launch, running A/B tests or cohort comparisons to evaluate results objectively. Continuously iterate across successive releases. Transparently retire approaches that fail to deliver results. User Research & Stakeholder Engagement Interface directly with students, instructors, campus operations teams, and internal groups without middle layers. Perform post-launch follow-ups to verify actual problem resolution. Communication & Business Impact Articulate product builds, quantitative changes, and strategic learnings in clear business terms (student outcomes, engagement metrics, operational efficiency). Present progress at company-wide town halls within your first 2 months. Candidate Profile Must-Have Attributes Communication: Concise, clear written and verbal communication. Ability to summarize complex ideas simply. Agility: Fast learner capable of mastering new platforms, technical frameworks, and codebases within days. Ownership: Strong personal accountability and professional maturity to drive initiatives to completion. Product Thinking: Problem-first methodology with strong root-cause analysis and prioritization capabilities. Hands-on Building: Demonstrated experience shipping functional apps or prototypes using AI tools ("vibe coding" experience is acceptable). Prompting & Model Control: Proven ability to direct AI models to consistent, high-quality outcomes. Data Literacy: Familiarity with basic data tools (SQL or spreadsheets) to evaluate hypothesis metrics. Good-to-Have Knowledge or interest in cognitive science, learning design, or teaching/tutoring experience. Prior product-related coursework, hackathon entries, or side project portfolios. Location and Work Week Hyderabad (5 days/week in-office). Monday to Friday Internship Period (36 Months): 30,000 50,000 per month stipend, dependent on candidate evaluation. Conversion: Performance during the internship forms the basis for full-time conversion. Full-time compensation packages are finalized upon conversion.
